messages:
Noah: PSA: someone left Phil (the office palm) in the standup room with a tiny post-it that says 'On Mute' 😂
Erin: that was me. i gave him a tiny scarf because it was drafty. surprised he didn’t ask for a latte.
Kai: (posts photo: https://imgur.com/phil-palm) phil is thriving. also he now has a tiny nameplate that reads 'Phil the Unflappable'.
Maya: we are officially a biodome. adding 'Phil' to the org chart under morale.
Jordan: new nickname proposals for Erin: "Plant Dad", "Phil Whisperer", "Leaf Concierge"
Erin: i accept "Phil Whisperer" but it's a heavy title. training required.
Noah: liturgy idea: before major releases we assemble Phil and whisper positive affirmations. reduces stress by 2% (unverified).
Kai: also can we start a watering rota? i propose `Tue/Thu` quick mist and `Sat` deep soak.
Maya: voting: rota in Google Sheet (:thumbsup:), rota on whiteboard (:tada:), no rota, trust the plant (:no_entry_sign:)
Jordan: :thumbsup: (for the sheet)
Erin: :thumbsup:
Kai: :tada: (i like the whiteboard vibe)
Reacji Bot: added :phil_palm: emoji to workspace (reaction: :sparkles:)
Noah: outcome: Google Sheet it is. Erin will seed the first entries. i'll set reminders.
Maya: merch idea: tiny embroidered phil patch with "Unflappable" caption. 30 stickers? 10 patches?
Erin: unofficial tradition: anyone who forgets standup has to do a 5-second plant serenade.
Jordan: add to onboarding: "Phil Protocol - optional serenades encouraged"
Kai: pro tip: phil likes ambient synth, not dubstep. he is sensitive.
Maya: this thread is now canon. pinned in #random: "Phil the Palm - lore & protocol"
Reacji Bot: pinned message to #random: "Phil lore: watering rota link + merch plan"
Noah: future onboarding doc blurb: "Phil keeps us human. be kind to the plants and bring snacks for Erin."
Erin: snacks are for Phil or for me? important clarification.
Kai: both. life priorities. :seedling:
